tasks.short: Train the crew on this site's hazardous waste cleanup procedure.

steps.what: Pull the hazardous waste procedure that applies on this site.
Prepare cleanup examples from this site's waste and technologies.

loop.input: The procedure pack and this site's waste codes
loop.output: Worked examples that use only those codes
loop.check: The manager deletes an example that uses a code not on this site
loop.stop: One draft; a foreign code is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: Examples have to match this site's waste, not a generic course

steps.what: Train the crew on the hazardous cleanup procedure.
Sign attendance and the gaps still to close.

tasks.design: The procedure for this site's waste is pulled from the library, and examples are drafted only from those codes. The manager trains the crew in person. Attendance and gaps are signed by the manager. Works-council consent applies before staff training records are kept.
tasks.previous_blocker: Courses were generic, so the manager rebuilt examples from this site's waste each time.
tasks.enabler_now: A library can supply the procedure. Teaching a crew to do it on this ground cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing that a person has not understood a step that the attendance record would mark as done.
tasks.human_edge: The manager watches the hands, not only the sign-in.
tasks.altitude: Teaching stays the week. Rebuilding a generic course shrinks. Nothing moves the training itself off the site.

reach.task: Keep the hazardous-procedure library that training must use
reach.learn: Which procedure version is current for this waste before the session

evidence.claim: A protocol library stores procedures and can route a record to the person in charge.
Teaching a crew a hazardous procedure stays with a person.
Rosters and staff records need works-council consent under WOR art. 27.

assumptions: Focal role is the brownfield site manager. Boundary: from the current procedure to a signed attendance and gap list. The crew's later work on the load is a separate task.
Structured fields are procedure id, waste code, example, person and gap. The procedure library and the manager produce them. Fallback: an example that uses a code not on this site is removed.
Configure the procedure record in the {LMS} before custom code.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers a procedure revision before the next session.
WOR art. 27, as named in the digest, means staff attendance records need works-council consent. Do not start the record before that consent.
unknowns: Whether a procedure library already exists for this waste.
Whether the works council has already consented to training records.
research_questions: What share of the session is practice rather than slides?
How often does a gap have to be trained again?

incremental.description: Revise examples when the waste codes on the site change

approvals.approved_version: attendance and gap list the manager signed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the procedure does not match the site, so examples are rewritten and the session is unchanged. High: the procedure is current and only the pack shrinks. Teaching stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan revegetation of the brownfield and issue the mix the walk accepted.

steps.what: Read soil limits that a revegetation plan must tolerate.

loop.input: The soil certificate and the constraints
loop.output: Rows for contaminant, concentration and limit
loop.check: The manager checks each limit against the constraint list
loop.stop: One pass; a contaminant with no limit stays blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Certificates and constraints are separate documents

steps.what: Match plant species to those soil limits from the list.
Choose the revegetation mix and the planting sequence.
Draft the brownfield revegetation plan from that choice.

loop.input: The planting choice and the soil limits
loop.output: Plan sections that cite a species and a limit
loop.check: The manager cuts a species that is not on the choice
loop.stop: One draft; an extra species is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The plan must follow the mix just chosen, not a catalogue

steps.what: Walk the planting ground with the landscaper.
Issue the revegetation plan the walk accepted.

tasks.design: Soil limits are listed and species that cannot tolerate them drop off the shortlist. The manager chooses the mix, drafts the plan from that choice, and walks it. The plan is issued only for the version the walk accepted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Species were picked from a catalogue, then found not to tolerate the soil.
tasks.enabler_now: A species list can drop plants that fail a numeric soil limit. Choosing the mix for this slope and this use cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing a mix that will establish on the actual ground, not only on the certificate.
tasks.human_edge: The manager sees compaction, shade and slopes the certificate does not record.

ambition.what: A species that fails a soil limit is dropped before the planting walk, not after the plants arrive.

tasks.altitude: The walk stays. Catalogue searching shrinks. The manager can refuse a species the limit or the walk rejected.

reach.task: Set revegetation outcomes the organisation will count as a benefit
reach.learn: Which planting outcomes may be claimed as a regeneration benefit

evidence.claim: Matching a species tolerance to a numeric soil limit is a rules filter.
Choosing a planting mix for a real slope stays with the person who walked it.

assumptions: Focal role is the brownfield site manager. Boundary: from soil limits to an issued planting plan. Establishing the plants is later work.
Structured fields are contaminant, concentration, limit, species and tolerance. The certificate and the species list produce them. Fallback: a contaminant with no limit does not clear a species.
Configure the species filter before custom code.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers species tolerances added to the list.
The plan does not claim a biodiversity credit. That would be a separate commitment.
unknowns: Whether a species list with tolerances already exists.
Whether the landscaper or the manager chooses the mix.
research_questions: What share of catalogue species fail the soil limits on a typical site?
How often does the walk change the mix?

incremental.description: Update species tolerances when the list is revised

approvals.approved_version: planting plan accepted on the walk

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: tolerances are unknown, so the shortlist is useless and the walk chooses everything. High: limits and tolerances exist and only the filter and the draft shrink. The choice and the walk stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Testify on the contamination and the cleanup, using only the exhibit bundle.

steps.what: Assemble exhibits on contamination and the cleanup already on file.
Draft a chronology that cites only those contamination exhibits.

loop.output: Chronology sentences that each cite an exhibit id
loop.check: The manager deletes a sentence with no exhibit id
loop.stop: One draft; an uncited sentence is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: Testimony cannot rely on a sentence that has no exhibit

steps.what: Decide what testimony will and will not be given.
Give expert witness testimony on the contamination and the cleanup.
Counsel asks for a correction to the testimony record.

tasks.design: Exhibits already on the file are bundled, and a chronology may cite only those ids. The manager decides what they will say, then testifies. Counsel's request for a correction is counsel's work. A sentence with no exhibit is not used.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hearing bundles were assembled by hand from the whole project history.
tasks.enabler_now: A file can list exhibits. Saying what they mean under questions cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Answering a question that reaches past the exhibits without inventing a fact.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows what they saw, and what they will not say.
tasks.altitude: Hearings stay. Collating the bundle shrinks. The manager can refuse a chronology line that has no exhibit. Decision rights on what to say do not move.

reach.task: Confirm which permit version the testimony may rely on
reach.learn: Which permit version is the one the hearing is about

evidence.claim: A compliance review partly drafted by a model cited sources that were not real, and the fee was repaid.
Expert testimony stays with the person who will be questioned.

assumptions: Focal role is the brownfield site manager. Counsel's time is not the manager's saving. Boundary: from the site file to testimony given. The hearing outcome is not this task.

Structured fields are exhibit id, date, contaminant and document type. The site record produces them. Fallback: a fact with no exhibit id is deleted from the chronology and is not spoken from the draft.
Use the {DOCS} bundle index before custom code.
Upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the index fields when a new exhibit type is added.
The draft is not the testimony. The manager speaks, and may depart from the draft when the truth requires it.
unknowns: Whether exhibits are already indexed by id.
Whether counsel or the manager decides the limits of the testimony.
research_questions: What share of hearing questions stay inside the exhibit bundle?
How often is a chronology line cut because it has no exhibit?

incremental.description: Extend the exhibit index when a new document type is used in hearings

approvals.approved_version: exhibit bundle and testimony limits the manager took into the hearing

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the file is unindexed, so the bundle is collated by hand and the hearing is unchanged. High: exhibits are indexed and only the chronology shrinks. Testimony stays. Counsel time is not saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still site walks, crew briefings and hearings. Constraint lists, permit fields and cost lines are ready before the visit. The manager can stop a method, a filing or a price that is not on a checked version.
reach: Construction managers: sequence demolition so contamination is not spread
Compliance managers: say which breaches are notified the same day
Regulatory affairs managers: keep the permit condition list current
skills_to_grow: Checking an extracted constraint against the source line
Reading a laboratory certificate without treating a blank as zero
Holding a filing or a price that is not the checked version
role.ambitious_version: Each site carries a versioned constraint list, each filing uses fields the manager has checked, and each on-site commitment stays inside a limit already signed.

job.title: Brownfield Redevelopment Specialists and Site Managers
